en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-132 According to the same documentation, Ali ibn Abi Talib (a.s.) said, “

Talha ibn Obaydillah went to see God’s Prophet (S). There was a quince in the Prophet’s (a.s.) hand. The Prophet (S) gave it to him and said, “O Aba Muhammad (Talha)! Take this since it will relieve the heart.”
